name: @fuaran-ui/schema
description: TypeScript shape of the Fuaran UI §4b typed record contract — tagged unions for every NodeKind / LayoutKind / DisplayKind / InputKind / VisKind / Spec, branded NodeId / FragmentId, bounded primitives, and declarative Defaults.* constants.
